text: Lemon juice curdles the hot milk as for chhena; the curd is moulded, salted and optionally smoked. Heat of the milk and smoking method are not given.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The curd is put into small baskets or perforated pots.
The cheese is salted heavily, so that it keeps.
